## FAQ
- **How does the consultation process work?** Book a tier matching your needs. Our engineers will conduct a thorough diagnosis during the session and provide a clear roadmap. Consultation fees cover the initial deep diagnosis and tailored blueprint before any custom build pricing is discussed.
- **Do you offer offline AI solutions?** Yes. We specialize in lightweight desktop applications and AI models that run entirely offline — no cloud dependency required. Perfect for environments with limited connectivity.
- **What industries do you serve?** We serve businesses across Nigeria and beyond — from SMEs needing digital transformation to enterprises requiring custom software, AI integration, and tech education programs.
- **Is DroneBug officially registered?** Yes. DroneBug Technologies is a verified micro-enterprise registered with SMEDAN (Small and Medium Enterprises Development Agency of Nigeria). View certificate above.
- **How can I get started?** Choose a consultation tier above, or reach out via WhatsApp, Telegram, or email. We typically respond within 2 hours during business hours.

## Products
- **DIRMS Storebox (DroneBug Inventory and Records Management System) v2.1.0** — Free/open-source, offline-first Windows desktop app: POS checkout with discounts and seasonal coupons, inventory catalog, sales, customer credit ledger, expense tracker, thermal receipt printing, barcode generation, SQLite backup/restore. The free edition covers POS, inventory, sales, customers, expenses, hardware config, backups and customizable receipts; Financial Records, Analytics, most Admin features and extra themes require PRO or a customized version. Review + screenshots: https://www.dronebugtech.shop/products/dirms — Latest download (.exe ~5.4MB): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ABugDrone/joainas-supermarket-pos/main/bundle/DIRMS%20Storebox_2.1.0_x64-setup.exe (mirror: https://www.dronebugtech.shop/downloads/DIRMS_2.1.0_x64-setup.exe, source: https://github.com/ABugDrone/joainas-supermarket-pos) — Older builds: v1.6.0 Global (https://www.dronebugtech.shop/downloads/DIRMS_1.6.0_x64-setup.exe) and v1.5.0 (https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=1T00q-nzmqP0CpLf2ED9UOMWK-vg0TyLp&export=download&authuser=0, mirror: https://www.dronebugtech.shop/downloads/DIRMS_1.5.0_x64-setup.exe).
- **DSMS (DroneBug Sheets Management System)** — In development, coming soon. Offline Excel companion: Organize, Analyze, Simplify, Achieve. Preview: https://www.dronebugtech.shop/products/dsms
- **MyPettyTrading** — 100% offline Android pocket bookkeeper for petty traders, shops, and stalls. Sales, expenses, market lists, customer credit/debtor book, inventory (Products/Services/Edibles), branded receipts, CSV/XLSX import-export, multi-language (English, French, Arabic, Hausa, Yorùbá), and optional local Wi-Fi sync for up to 10 staff. Review: https://www.dronebugtech.shop/products/mypettytrading — Privacy Policy: https://www.dronebugtech.shop/privacy-policy
